actions.title: Add a member to an account
actions.description: Add a user to an account with a coarse role (member/admin/owner).

role.description: The coarse account role: member | admin | owner.

actions.title: Create an organization account
actions.description: Create a new organization account, optionally seeding its owner (defaults to the caller).

owner_id.description: User id to seed as the owner member. Omit to default to the caller.

actions.title: Remove a member from an account
actions.description: Remove a user from an account. The backend refuses (422 LAST_OWNER) removing the sole owner.

actions.title: Change a member's role on an account
actions.description: Change an existing member's coarse role. The backend refuses (422 LAST_OWNER) demoting the sole owner.

role.description: The coarse account role: member | admin | owner.

actions.title: Navigate the app to a route
Update session settings
actions.description: Update the auth session token lifetimes (access-token expiry hours, refresh-token expiry days). Each field is optional; omit to leave unchanged.

actions.title: Clear an account's plan override
actions.description: Release an account's manual plan override so Stripe controls the plan again (the explicit release path).

account_id.description: The account id to act on (resolve it from the Accounts admin list).

actions.title: Grant overage credit to an account
actions.description: Add a positive credit grant (in cents of overage-admission budget) to an account's ledger, with a reason and an optional expiry.

account_id.description: The account id to act on (resolve it from the Accounts admin list).

amount_cents.description: The grant amount in integer CENTS (must be > 0).

reason.description: Why the credit is granted (required, non-empty).

expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry; omit for a grant that never expires.

actions.title: Reactivate an admin-suspended account
actions.description: Lift the admin hold on an account. Does NOT clear a real billing suspension (that lifts only when the invoice is paid).

account_id.description: The account id to act on (resolve it from the Accounts admin list).

actions.title: Revoke a credit grant
actions.description: Revoke an account's credit grant. The grant row is NOT deleted — it stays in the ledger stamped revoked (append-only, auditable).

account_id.description: The account id to act on (resolve it from the Accounts admin list).

grant_id.description: The id of the grant to revoke.

actions.title: Set an account's plan (admin override)
actions.description: Directly set an account's plan/tier (an admin comp, no Stripe round-trip). The override WINS until explicitly cleared.

account_id.description: The account id to act on (resolve it from the Accounts admin list).

plan_id.description: The target plan id from the plan catalog (e.g. "free" / "pro").

actions.title: Toggle an account premium (unlimited) comp
actions.description: Comp an account to unlimited plan allowance (premium override), or clear it. Does NOT bypass a suspension.

account_id.description: The account id to act on (resolve it from the Accounts admin list).

premium.description: true → comp to unlimited; false → clear the comp.

actions.title: Suspend (disable) an account
actions.description: Place an admin hold on an account (blocks compute + storage), independent of its billing status. An admin hold is NOT overridable by credits/premium.

account_id.description: The account id to act on (resolve it from the Accounts admin list).

reason.description: Optional operator reason for the hold (shown on the account status).

actions.title: Test the Stripe connection
actions.description: Validate the stored (or a just-typed, un-persisted) Stripe secret with one lightweight Stripe call. Returns {ok,message} — never the key.

stripe_secret.description: A candidate key to test WITHOUT storing. Absent ⇒ test the stored/env key.

actions.title: Update the Stripe integration config (rotate secret / prices)
actions.description: Set/rotate the Stripe secret and/or webhook signing secret (stored ENCRYPTED at rest) and the price-ID mapping. A blank/absent secret field leaves the stored secret unchanged. Never returns the plaintext.

stripe_secret.description: A NEW Stripe secret key to store (encrypted). Blank/absent ⇒ unchanged.

webhook_secret.description: A NEW Stripe webhook signing secret to store. Blank/absent ⇒ unchanged.

prices.description: Replacement Stripe price-ID map, keyed by the catalog price env-name.

actions.title: Add dataset
actions.description: Open the datasets panel and pick a dataset to link to this project.

actions.title: Add dataset by id
actions.description: Link a specific dataset to this project by id, visibly driving the datasets panel (pick + attach).

actions.title: List datasets to link
actions.description: List the datasets available to link to this project (id + name), for choosing one to add.

actions.title: Export a frozen collection as GMT
Parse text into a list field
Clear a per-account feature-flag override (revert to inherit)
actions.description: Remove a feature flag's PER-ACCOUNT override for one account, so the account reverts to inheriting the global default (or the compiled default).

account_id.description: The account UUID whose override should be cleared.

actions.title: Enable or disable a feature flag for one account (per-account override)
actions.description: Set a PER-ACCOUNT override for a feature flag (on/off) for a single account, leaving the global default and other accounts untouched.

account_id.description: The account UUID to override the flag for.

enabled.description: true enables the feature for this account, false disables it.

actions.title: Enable or disable a feature flag (global default)
actions.description: Set a feature flag's GLOBAL default on or off for the whole deployment (no per-account override).

enabled.description: true enables the feature globally, false disables it.

actions.title: Assign a user to a group
actions.description: Add a user to a user group (grants the group's permissions to that user).

group_id.description: The user-group id to act on.

actions.title: Create a user group
actions.description: Create a new user group with a name, optional description, and a permission set.

permissions.description: The permission keys the group grants.

actions.title: Delete a user group
actions.description: Permanently delete a user group.

id.description: The user-group id to act on.

actions.title: Remove a user from a group
actions.description: Remove a user from a user group.

group_id.description: The user-group id to act on.

actions.title: Edit a user group
actions.description: Update a group's name, description, active status, or permission set.

id.description: The user-group id to act on.

is_active.description: New active status (omit to leave unchanged).

permissions.description: New permission set (omit to leave unchanged).

actions.title: Describe the demo instance harness (its current value + state token)
Set the demo instance harness value
Cancel / revert migration to the old object store
actions.description: Abandon a verified object-store migration and revert the primary back to the OLD store (atomic swap; no restart). Use after cutting over live and changing your mind. The old store is never deleted and the new store's copy is left in place — nothing is deleted. Clears the config-change block so the store can be reconfigured. Returns {abandoned, reverted_to, config_reverted}.

confirm.description: Must be true to abandon the migration and revert to the old store.

actions.title: Acknowledge egress cost & start the parked migration
actions.description: Acknowledge the cross-cloud EGRESS COST for a migration PARKED awaiting a cost acknowledgement (`awaiting_cost_ack`) and START the copy. Use after reviewing the estimate (blobs + bytes). Returns the updated migration status.

id.description: The parked (pending) migration to acknowledge + start. Absent ⇒ the newest pending one.

actions.title: Confirm the old object store is safe to retire
actions.description: After a verified migration, confirm the OLD object store is SAFE to retire: re-verifies every blob is present in the destination and that no jobs are running. Deletes nothing — returns {safe_to_retire, verified_blobs}. The old store is then deleted MANUALLY.

confirm.description: Must be true to run the retire-readiness check.

access_key_id.description: Destination access key (used only to build the store handle; not persisted here).

dest.description: The destination every blob must be verified present in.

actions.title: Round-trip test the compute↔storage pair
actions.description: Prove the SELECTED compute backend can write to AND read from the SELECTED object store (a real put/get/verify/delete round-trip through the pair) — the end-to-end check two green per-service tests can't give. Returns {ok,message}.

actions.title: Migrate object-store data to a new store
actions.description: Start a copy+verify data migration from the CURRENT object store to a destination store. Every blob is copied under its content-addressed key and verified by content hash; a mismatch halts and rolls back. The source is never deleted. A large cross-cloud move requires cost_ack:true (surfaced as an estimate first).

access_key_id.description: Destination access key (used only to build the store handle; not persisted here).

cost_ack.description: Explicit go-ahead for a large cross-cloud (egress-billing) move.

actions.title: Test the compute cluster connection
actions.description: Test the configured compute cluster by reaching the API and listing nodes. Optionally override the kubeconfig with a just-typed candidate (not persisted). Returns {ok,message} — never the credential.

kubeconfig.description: A candidate kubeconfig to test WITHOUT storing. Absent ⇒ stored/ambient.

actions.title: Test the object-store connection
actions.description: Test the configured object store with a put/get/delete round-trip. Optionally override the credentials with just-typed candidates (not persisted). Returns {ok,message} — never the secret.

access_key_id.description: A candidate access key to test WITHOUT storing. Absent ⇒ stored/env.

secret_access_key.description: A candidate secret key to test WITHOUT storing.

actions.title: Update the compute backend config (Kubernetes)
actions.description: Set/rotate the compute backend config: backend/cluster-endpoint/namespace/worker-image and the kubeconfig/cluster-token (stored ENCRYPTED at rest). A blank/absent secret leaves the stored credential unchanged. Never returns the plaintext.

kubeconfig.description: A NEW kubeconfig to store (encrypted). Blank/absent ⇒ unchanged.

token.description: A NEW cluster token to store (encrypted). Blank/absent ⇒ unchanged.

actions.title: Update the object-store backend config (S3/GCS)
actions.description: Set/rotate the object-store backend config: backend/provider/endpoint/bucket/region and the S3 access-key/secret-key (stored ENCRYPTED at rest). A blank/absent secret leaves the stored credential unchanged. Never returns the plaintext.

access_key_id.description: A NEW access key to store (encrypted). Blank/absent ⇒ unchanged.

secret_access_key.description: A NEW secret key to store (encrypted). Blank/absent ⇒ unchanged.

actions.title: Update job scheduler settings
actions.description: Update the job settings (max concurrent jobs, per-tenant cap, reserved interactive slots, SSE keep-alive seconds + max clients, admission wait seconds + poll ms, and the scheduler/reaper timing knobs: heartbeat, reaper tick, stale threshold, max reclaims, reclaim batch, dispatch tick, metric tick). Each field is optional; omit to leave unchanged.

sse_max_clients.description: Max concurrent per-job SSE subscribers (1-4096; OOM guard).

admission_poll_ms.description: Admission poll interval in ms (10-10000; must be < wait*1000).

stale_threshold_secs.description: Stale-reclaim threshold in seconds (5-3600; must be >= 3x heartbeat_secs).

metric_tick_secs.description: CPU/RSS metric sampling cadence in seconds (1-60).

actions.title: Update MCP settings
actions.description: Update the MCP agent/tool caps (max concurrent control sessions, max in-flight invokes per user, per-action wall-clock backstop, list-capabilities cap, invoke result-byte cap) and the pairing-code TTL. Each field is optional; omit to leave unchanged. Values are bounded (safety limits).

max_control_sessions.description: Global cap on live agent control sessions — an OOM safety limit (16..16384).

max_inflight_per_user.description: Per-user cap on concurrent in-flight invokes — a DoS safety limit (1..256).

action_wall_clock_secs.description: Outer wall-clock backstop on one dispatched action, in seconds (30..3600).

max_list_results.description: Cap on capabilities returned by one list_capabilities call (1..2000).

max_result_bytes.description: Cap on the invoke result body relayed to the model, in bytes — an OOM safety limit (1 KiB..64 MiB).

actions.title: Go to AI Assistant Access settings
Pop the pane out to a window
Return the pane to the main window
Record selection provenance
actions.description: Persist the committed selection as a durable recipe (the run criteria + pinned input) in the project provenance graph.

actions.title: Update provenance settings
actions.description: Update the provenance capture/export/verify settings (byte caps, retention, budgets, methods-LLM-polish toggle). Each field is optional; omit to leave unchanged.

rootfs_gc_interval_secs.description: Rootfs-cache GC sweep interval in seconds (60..604800).

rootfs_cache_max_digests.description: Rootfs image-cache size cap — max digest dirs kept (1..1000).

actions.title: Update sandbox resource limits
actions.description: Update the code-sandbox resource limits (CPU, memory, pids, file sizes, timeouts), the per-class resource defaults (interactive/normal/batch), and the deployment default environment image id. Each field is optional; omit to leave unchanged.

address_space_bytes.description: Max virtual address space in bytes.

interactive_cpu_cores.description: Default CPU cores for interactive-priority jobs.

normal_cpu_cores.description: Default CPU cores for normal-priority jobs.

batch_cpu_cores.description: Default CPU cores for batch-priority jobs.

default_env_id.description: Deployment default environment-image id (empty string = auto-detect from installed processors).

Create a user

permissions.description: Optional list of permission keys to grant the user.

actions.description: Permanently delete a user account.

id.description: The user id to act on (the row `id`).

actions.title: Toggle a user's premium (unlimited) comp
actions.description: Comp a user's personal account to unlimited plan allowance (premium override), or clear it. Does NOT bypass a suspension. Refreshes the Users tier column.

account_id.description: The user's personal account id (the row's `personal_account_id`; the user must have one).

premium.description: true → comp to unlimited; false → clear the comp.

actions.title: Grant overage credit to a user's account
actions.description: Add a positive credit grant (in integer CENTS of overage-admission budget) to a user's personal account, with a reason and an optional expiry. Refreshes the Users tier column.

account_id.description: The user's personal account id (the row's `personal_account_id`; the user must have one).

amount_cents.description: The grant amount in integer CENTS (must be > 0).

reason.description: Why the credit is granted (required, non-empty).

expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry; omit for a grant that never expires.

actions.title: Reset a user's password
actions.description: Set a new password for a user (an admin reset, not a self-service change).

id.description: The user id to act on (the row `id`).

actions.title: Toggle a user's active status
actions.description: Activate or deactivate a user account (flips the current active status). A deactivated user cannot sign in.

id.description: The user id to act on (the row `id`).

actions.title: Edit a user's profile
actions.description: Update a user's username, display name, or active status.

id.description: The user id to act on (the row `id`).

display_name.description: New display name (omit to leave unchanged).

is_active.description: New active status (omit to leave unchanged).

actions.title: Describe a live view instance (its current state + state token)
List every live, AI-drivable view instance
Update workstore settings
actions.description: Update the workstore GC policy (sweep on/off, cadence, orphan-grace), ingest size caps (max single-file bytes, max multi-file total bytes), and upload limits (max upload body bytes — SaaS only, max upload parts — both modes). Each field is optional; omit to leave unchanged. Values are bounded (safety limits).

max_output_file_bytes.description: Ingest ceiling on a single output file / member, in bytes (1 MiB..64 GiB).

max_multifile_total_bytes.description: Ingest ceiling on a multi-file artifact total, in bytes (1 MiB..256 GiB).

max_upload_body_bytes.description: SaaS-only ceiling on a dataset UPLOAD request body, in bytes (1 MiB..256 GiB). Self-hosted uploads are uncapped and ignore this value.

max_upload_parts.description: Ceiling on the number of parts in one multipart upload, in BOTH modes (1..65536).
